mapper.sql: FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat c ON c.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN merchant_application a ON a.reserved_merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN merchant_agreement_current cur ON cur.agreement_key = 'MERCHANT' LEFT JOIN merchant_agreement_acceptance acc ON acc.merchant_id = m.id AND acc.agreement_version_id = cur.agreement_version_id LEFT JOIN merchant_agreement_version v ON v.id = cur.agreement_version_id

SELECT m.id, m.merchant_name, m.status, m.provider_merchant_no, m.created_at, m.version, c.merchant_type_code, c.city_code, a.id AS application_id, a.application_no, a.status AS application_status, a.submitted_at AS application_submitted_at, a.reviewed_at AS application_reviewed_at, acc.accepted_at AS signing_accepted_at, v.agreement_version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id) AS store_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_store_count

sql.if: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.status = #{storeStatus})
AND (m.merchant_name LIKE #{keyword} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.store_name LIKE #{keyword}))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat c ON c.merchant_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, store_name, address, status FROM merchant_store WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_staff WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT mb.id AS member_id, g.store_id AS store_id, mb.status AS member_status, mb.version AS member_version, g.status AS grant_status, g.version AS grant_version, inv.member_name AS member_name, inv.phone AS phone, mb.created_at AS created_at, mb.updated_at AS updated_at FROM merchant_member mb LEFT JOIN merchant_member_store_grant g ON g.member_id = mb.id LEFT JOIN merchant_member_invitation inv ON inv.member_id = mb.id AND inv.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE mb.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
ORDER BY mb.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_member mb LEFT JOIN merchant_member_store_grant g ON g.member_id = mb.id WHERE mb.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT member_id AS owner_id, action_code AS action_code FROM merchant_member_store_action WHERE member_id IN #{memberId} ORDER BY member_id ASC, action_code ASC
SELECT invitation_id AS owner_id, action_code AS action_code FROM merchant_member_invitation_action WHERE invitation_id IN #{invitationId} ORDER BY invitation_id ASC, action_code ASC
